description: First-token candidates from a chat model, one forward pass per question. `top` holds the most likely first tokens and their natural-log probabilities. `noul` items are yes/no questions about the labeled drafts in ../harness-lab/fixtures/decisions.json (label true = the draft was good). `choice` items ask which category a message belongs to; the model was shown the categories as lettered options, and `letters` maps each letter back to its category.

options.refunds: Money back for an order: how much, when it is released, or where it is sent.
options.returns: Sending an item back: eligibility, the return window, labels, restocking fees.
options.shipping: Delivery of an outbound order: transit times, cutoffs, tracking, delays.
options.billing: Subscription invoices and payment: charges, declined cards, retries, a paused account.
options.sla: Service uptime and the credits owed when it is missed.
options.rate_limits: API request limits, 429 errors, concurrency, and API keys.
options.account_access: Signing in: passwords, lockouts, two-factor codes, recovery.
options.data_retention: How long Northstar keeps data and when it is deleted.
